context: For the short-term (five days or less) management of acute pain, the recommended dose of tramadol hydrochloride and acetaminophen tablets, 37.5 mg/325 mg, is 2 tablets every 4 to 6 hours as needed for pain relief up to a maximum of 8 tablets per day.
